title: Next Month's Rent in a Catch-Up Amount
content:
Whether an Apartment Home Lease catch-up amount carries the next month's rent follows the tenure: a lease in possession for 36 full calendar months or more never carries it; a lease in possession for 12 to 35 full calendar months carries it only when the handling date falls on one of the 3 days before the next rent due date; any other lease carries it on one of the 10 days before.

Full calendar months are counted from the move-in date (read from the lease record) to the same day number of a later month. The next rent due date is the day after the last day of the late period, and the rent carried is the monthly rent in force.

## Guidance table

| Full calendar months in possession | Days before the next rent due date on which the next month's rent is carried |
|---|---|
| 36 or more | never |
| 12 to 35 | 1 to 3 |
| 11 or fewer | 1 to 10 |

## Examples (hypothetical, late period April, next rent due date 1 May)

| Months in possession | Handling date 25 April (6 days before) | Handling date 29 April (2 days before) |
|---|---|---|
| 8 | carried | carried |
| 20 | not carried | carried |
| 40 | not carried | not carried |

**Tenure boundary.** Move-in on 15 May 2023: on 14 May 2026 the lease has 35 full months and falls in the 12-to-35 row; on 15 May 2026 it has 36 and never carries the next month's rent.
